2/1 booklet

181 pages for the 956 auctions that came up at least 100 times in 100000 deals the robot bid against itself. Each page is the choice after the auctions it lists. The calls are in order of how often they were made, and a bar shows at which count of points: the darker the block, the larger the share of hands with that many points that make the call. Point the mouse at a call for what the system says it means.
